fees_2026_05.notes: Official rate card is the source of record (golfpondokindah.com, valid through 31 December 2026). Friday is treated as a premium weekday at IDR 1,928,000.

GoGolf English course page 404s; that platform does not list Pondok Indah.

fees_2026_05.notes: All slot-by-slot AM/PM/Night verified via Q-Access. 'Publish' = official rack rate; 'QGolf' = discounted in-app rate (the rate Indonesian residents typically pay). Existing dataset values (weekday 870K, weekend 2,000K, guest 2,860K) are PROMO/BLENDED, not the base publish rate; replaced with full publish + QGolf grid. Rate includes green fee, caddy and golf cart sharing. Inclusions confirmed by gogolf.co.id Indonesian language article.

fees_2026_05.notes: Official rate card (gadingrayagolf.com/green_fees.html) confirms guest weekday IDR 850,000 (Tue-Fri), Mon-PM IDR 720,000, Sat/Sun-AM IDR 2,200,000, Sat-PM IDR 1,700,000, Sun-PM IDR 1,500,000. Member rate is IDR 280,000 — a caddy/registration fee since members pay no green fee. Guest rates INCLUDE green fee, caddy fee, and golf cart sharing (per official site). The 280K member vs 850K guest gap is genuine and validated — members hold equity and pay only operational/caddy charges. Q-Access lists matching publish rates (720K Monday, 850K Tue-Fri; weekend 2,200K AM, 1,700K Sat-PM, 1,500K Sun-PM) plus QGolf-app discount tier (640-670K weekday, 1,145-1,745K weekend) for non-members. fees_2026_05.notes: Official bukitdarmogolf.com/rates-fee-and-membership/ rate card (per indexed snippet): Saturday AM 975,000 / Saturday PM 775,000 / Sunday AM 875,000 / Sunday PM 675,000. The 'suspiciously close' 975k weekend figure is in fact the SATURDAY-AM peak rate; Sunday PM drops to 675k, so the full weekend curve is not flat. Direct fetches of bukitdarmogolf.com returned 403 Forbidden (anti-bot), but the indexed result confirms the rate card. GolfSavers lists 18H weekday 485-725k / weekend 635-935k (likely tier ranges incl. member). PlayGolf.id lists USD 44 WD / USD 100 WE (~700k / ~1.6M IDR — appears outdated). GolfCards.com shows base 600k with 'Wed-Sun + holidays 20% discount'. Membership tiers IDR 5.5M-39.9M annually with green-fee discounts. Existing 910k WD / 975k WE / 365k member retained as best estimate; weekend slots disaggregated.
fees_2026_05.official_site_status: live (403 to scrapers; indexed by Google)
fees_2026_05.verification_notes: Weekend slots resolved: Sat AM 975,000 (peak) vs Sun PM 675,000 (low). The 975k vs 910k closeness was a comparison artefact — 975k is Sat-AM peak, not a flat weekend rate. Sunday PM is materially lower than weekday (675k vs 910k), which is consistent with city-course pricing. Weekday AM/PM split not separately published (treated as flat). Caddy/cart/insurance not separately listed on the rate card snippet — left null.

fees_2026_05.notes: COURSE PERMANENTLY CLOSED. Padang Golf Jaya Ancol (33.6 ha, 18-hole RTJ Jr. course) was shut down on 24 February 2010 and converted to Ancol Ecopark / Allianz Ecopark in collaboration with the KEHATI Biodiversity Foundation. The directory entries on mscorecard.com, golftoday.co.uk, and golfshake.com are stale legacy listings reflecting pre-2010 data. No current rates exist because no golf operation exists. Phone listing +62 21 682122 is also legacy.

JJC Japanese-member rate (per JJC official): weekend AM IDR 1.95M / PM IDR 1.5M, with competition rate (40+ players) AM 1.85M / PM 1.45M. Closed Mondays. Official rate sub-page returns 404.

courses.course_layout: 18-hole, par-72 course (~6,070 yds) in the Tigaraksa area of western Tangerang. Affordable, approachable layout.
courses.notes: Public-access Japanese-designed course in Tigaraksa, western Tangerang Regency, opened 1994. Part of the Tigaraksa Golf Residens estate.

fees_2026_05.notes: THREE-WAY CONFLICT RESOLVED. (1) GoGolf detailed course review (gogolf.co.id/en/golf-course/takara-golf-resort, published 2024-06 / updated 2025-11): weekday IDR 100,000 (women) / 150,000 (men); weekend IDR 345,000–455,000. Caddy included, NO buggy carts (course is walking-only). (2) GoGolf summary listing (gogolf.co.id/en/golf-tangerang) shows IDR 450,000 weekday / 650,000 weekend — this is a stale aggregated tile that conflicts with the same site's detailed review and is treated as out-of-date. (3) Playgolf.id (tigaraksagolf.com) USD 23 weekday / USD 60 weekend (~IDR 360k / 930k) is also outdated — it predates the course's repositioning as 'affordable / walking-only' under the Takara name. The 100/150K + 345-455K tier is the most recently published *and* most detailed source, and is consistent with the course's stated 'affordable / wallet-friendly' branding. Q-Access (qaccess.asia) returns ZERO results for 'takara' — the course is not on the QGolf platform, so no booking-platform corroboration available.
fees_2026_05.official_site_status: image-only — takara-golf.co.id and tigaraksagolf.com do not publish current rates online; greenfee365 lists course as 'not activated for booking'.
fees_2026_05.verification_notes: Takara/Tigaraksa is a walking-only, budget course; the dramatic price gap across sources reflects three eras: (a) original 1994 Tigaraksa Residens premium pricing on playgolf.id (USD-quoted), (b) intermediate IDR 450/650k aggregator listing, (c) current 2024-2025 affordable repositioning at IDR 100-150k / 345-455k. The current GoGolf Indonesian and English review (most recent 2025-11 update) is the source of record. No buggy carts. Phone +62 21 5991227 / +62 21 5996371 listed for direct verification.

courses.address: Jalan Terusan Kopo KM 8.4, Sulaiman, Margahayu, Bandung Regency, West Java 40229
courses.course_layout: 18 holes, par 72, ~6,386 m. Parkland-style with man-made undulating hills, water hazards, strategic bunkers, long par-5s (#14 ~500m, #17 ~516m). Cool climate at western edge of Bandung.
courses.notes: An 18-hole, par-72 championship course on the western edge of Bandung opened in 1994 to a Michael Coates design. Co-located with the Bandung Indah Waterpark, one of the most full-featured resort-style golf clubs in the Bandung area, open to the public daily.

fees_2026_05.inclusions_note: Per gogolf.co.id 2025 review: weekday from IDR 450k; weekend/holiday IDR 600k-850k. Caddie and buggy excluded from green fee. golfasian.com lists rentals at USD 30 cart / USD 25 club set / USD 8 shoes / USD 5 umbrella (~IDR 480k cart). Golfcards fee-card members get 30% wd / 20% we discount. Public access; designed 1994 by Michael Coate (AUS), 18-hole par-72.

courses.address: Jl. Raya Timur Km. 7 / Jl. Golf Barat Raya, Sukamiskin, Arcamanik, Bandung, West Java 40293
courses.course_layout: 18-hole parkland-style course built in 1970 inside the Arcamanik area of east Bandung, now part of the broader Jabar (West Java) Sport Center complex. Course is relatively flat.
courses.notes: One of Bandung's oldest 18-hole courses, opened 1970 inside the West Java provincial Arcamanik Sport Center (rebuilt for PON XIX 2016). Public/affordable round. Coordinates approximate (~-6.92, 107.67).

fees_2026_05.notes: No official site or 2026 rate card found. Only published source remains the historical jomkebandung blog (corrected: jomkebandung lists 9-hole non-member 150k weekday / 200k weekend; 18-hole non-member 80k weekday / 125k weekend; cart 120k; caddy 13k). Note jomkebandung tabulates the 9-hole rate ABOVE the 18-hole rate — the small 9-hole municipal course is the cheaper offering. The 'known_rates_existing' input had weekday and weekend at the same 200k value which appears to conflate 9-hole weekend non-member with both weekday and weekend; the blog distinguishes 9H 150k WD / 200k WE. Bahasa-Indonesia searches (Padang Golf Arcamanik biaya 2026 / tarif Arcamanik), Trip.com 2026 page, kumparan, expertgolf, leadingcourses, and Instagram all return no current published rate. Phone +62 22 7272891 is the official contact.
fees_2026_05.verification_notes: All AM/PM granularity unresolved — Arcamanik does not publish AM/PM splits (small 9-hole municipal course, walk-up pricing). Only weekday-vs-weekend, member-vs-non-member, and 9H-vs-18H tiers are published, and only on the jomkebandung blog (date unknown, likely 2018-2022). 2026 rates cannot be confirmed from any current source; values shown are the most recent published proxy.

courses.address: Jl. Letjen Djamin Ginting Km. 22, Uruk Gedang, Kec. Namorambe, Kabupaten Deli Serdang, Sumatera Utara 20353
courses.designer: Gus Grantham / JMP Golf Design Group
courses.course_layout: Championship 18-hole layout, 6,071 m from the back tees (Black 6,071 / Blue 5,633 / White 5,221 / Red 4,677). Bermuda greens and TifDwarf 419 fairways set in the rolling foothills south of Medan toward the Karo highlands.
courses.notes: Opened 1998, Martabe Sejahtera is a public-access 18-hole par-72 championship course in Namorambe, Deli Serdang, ~22 km south of central Medan on the Berastagi road. One of four major 18-hole layouts in Greater Medan (alongside Royal Sumatra, Tamora and Graha Metropolitan/Helvetia).
